cells.gaps: The one evidence row (ZMB-001) is from the excluded source and sets nothing, so no admissible statement that learner records are on paper is held. The systems on file are a yearly census, single-function tools and one district's monthly and termly reports; none is a record per learner that a primary school adds to during the year.
cells.note: The country holds only noted classes, and a census never places it above stage 1. Stage 1 is a claim and needs an admissible dated statement of paper-only records, which is not held.
